story: Conor and Jack Shanahan drove CUSCO Racing Toyota GR Corollas (Conor #97 Red Bull CUSCO, Jack #59 RADBODY CUSCO) as guest entries at the D1 Grand Prix season finale, Tokyo Drift at Odaiba, 14-15 November 2026. The result is not confirmed: do not name a winner or a placing.
title: CONOR AND JACK SHANAHAN IN D1GP
caption:
The brothers Shanahan made their D1GP debut as guest entries in Tokyo. What did you think of their performance?

Source: tip van Joshua
